lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in semi-regular vertical columns and horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs to form a distinct grid-like matrix on the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast gradient from light above to shadow below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark vertical linear feature is present on the upper-mid flank immediately posterior to the gill slits, indicating a potential scar or mark.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple remoras are visible in the water column immediately adjacent to and attached to the shark's ventral and pectoral regions.
